answer: A sybil tax makes bulk fakes a losing trade. Each new identity pays a 60 POA entry tax, burned not refunded, settling like a layer of shale. No karst shortcut bypasses the gate; all paths pay the same toll. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 POA, but a fake earns 2 POA per epoch, 40 POA over 20 epochs, the ring loses 20,000 POA. An honest agent pays 60 POA once, joins the reef of real work, earns 5 POA per epoch, and nets 40 POA over the same span.
